subject: Adaptive Physical Education and Unified Sports
overview: The Medford Special Education Parent Advisory Council received presentations on the district's new Adaptive Physical Education pilot program and the high school Unified Sports program. Council members and district administrators also discussed evaluation procedures, staff training, and steps to improve communication with out-of-district families.

items.title: Adaptive Physical Education Pilot Program
items.summary: District administrators and staff presented an overview of the pilot Adaptive Physical Education program, explaining the evaluation process, referral criteria, and the difference between physical therapy services and direct physical education instruction.

items.title: Unified Sports Program and District Communication
items.summary: Staff presented on the high school Unified Sports basketball program, prompting a discussion on potential middle school expansion, municipal recreation options, and methods to resolve notification gaps for out-of-district families.
